name: Tale
description: Coordinate people and AI agents in shared projects, delegate tasks to persistent sandboxes, and review results. Operate tasks, automations, and knowledge through REST and MCP.

skills.name: Delegate Project Tasks
skills.description: Assign project tasks to configured agents, run work in persistent sandboxes, and return deliverables for human review.

skills.name: Operate Automations
skills.description: Discover automation tools over MCP, validate and test workflows, deploy versions, and inspect or cancel durable runs.

skills.name: Retrieve Workspace Knowledge
skills.description: Retrieve passages from organization documents and crawled pages through the MCP get_knowledge tool, respecting access rules.
